Name: Jehoshaphat, Son of Nimshi
Summary: Jehoshaphat, son of Nimshi, was the father of Jehu king of Israel, through whom Jehu is named son of Jehoshaphat son of Nimshi.
RelatedPeople: Jehu, King of Israel; Nimshi, Grandfather of Jehu
LifeLesson: A father's name carried into a son's anointing is a quiet legacy.
